blocks.text: Special theory ke mutabiq time absolute (har jagah ek jaisa) nahi; yeh frame of reference ki motion par depend karta hai.

Farz karein ek observer inertial frame mein ruka hua hai aur isi frame mein do events ke darmiyan ka waqt naapta hai; yeh waqt tₒ hai. Ise proper time kehte hain. Agar observer events wale frame ke relative bohat tez (relativistic) velocity v se chal raha ho, ya woh frame observer ke relative uniform velocity v se chal raha ho, to observer ko yeh waqt tₒ nahi balke t milega:

√(1 − v²/c²) hamesha 1 se kam hai, is liye t, tₒ se bara hai: yani observer aur events ke frame ki relative motion se time phail (dilate) gaya. Yeh amazing (hairan kar dene wala) result (nateeja) har tarah ke waqt par lagu hai: physical, chemical aur biological. Bohat tez (relativistic) speed par human body (insaani jism) ka boorha hona bhi ahista ho jata hai.

Misal: 0.8 c se chalte jahaz mein musafir kitab utha kar kholta hai; musafir ke hisab se is mein ek second lagta hai. Magar jahaz ke bahar khare shakhs ke hisab se isi kaam mein 1.7 seconds lagte hain (1/√(1 − 0.64) = 1/0.6 ≈ 1.7).
